term: intrinsic source escaping along finite truncations
definition: At finite truncation n the only intrinsic source is the node indexed n; for each fixed node x there is a later truncation after which x is never an intrinsic source. At no fixed position is sourcehood eventually retained.
note: A mathematical pointwise-limit construction analogous to a moving urn token. It does not assert the existence of physical infinite resources, nor claim a real source can literally travel beyond an actual infinity.
